status: FROZEN -- awaiting explicit authorisation for a one-shot primary evaluation

supersedes.reason: that protocol calibrated on a carve drawn from the R3D training remainder. Source-disjointness does not imply training-disjointness; the measured memorization gap was +0.244 recall. The candidate set, the spatial feature, the fixed weight and the calibration method are carried over UNCHANGED -- only the calibration dataset is substituted, because the previous one was proved invalid.
supersedes.invalid_carve: temporal_risk/fresh_validation_carve.json (retained as evidence, never to be used for validation)

development_data.clips_unavailable_reason: 5 carve clips are recorded under sanitised Kaggle filenames that cannot be mapped to local mojibake filenames; the mapping is UNKNOWN and was not reconstructed
development_data.missingness_bias_direction: undefined spatial scores abstain (treated as spatial-negative). Most undefined clips are NonFight, for which abstention gives the CORRECT answer, so this mildly favours specificity and must be stated when reporting
development_data.status: DEVELOPMENT resource only. Genuine R3D holdout, but already spent for checkpoint selection, two aggregation selections and spatial characterization. Not an unbiased test set; no number here is a performance claim.

spatial_feature.name: speed_normalised_by_group_diagonal
spatial_feature.numerator: mean over all (track, frame) pairs of BehaviorAnalyzer._movement_pixels: Euclidean centroid displacement in raw image pixels between consecutive frames of the same track
spatial_feature.denominator: mean over frames containing at least one person of the diagonal of the bounding box enclosing ALL person boxes in that frame
spatial_feature.form: RATIO OF MEANS, not mean of ratios
spatial_feature.form_caveat: mean(speed)/mean(diagonal) is not equal to mean(speed/diagonal). This is a pre-specified approximation, documented rather than silently changed.
spatial_feature.single_person_clips: defined: the group diagonal collapses to that person's own box diagonal, so the feature becomes speed relative to apparent body size
spatial_feature.zero_person_frames: contribute to neither numerator nor denominator
spatial_feature.undefined_when: no consecutive-frame track pair exists, or the mean diagonal is zero
spatial_feature.zero_denominator: guarded; yields None rather than a division error
known_limitations: raw pixel motion is not compensated for camera motion; RWF-2000 Fight clips may be filmed differently from NonFight clips, and this protocol cannot separate subject motion from camera motion
tracker ID switches inflate apparent displacement; the high-quality subset probe argues against this dominating, but does not exclude it
the feature is a WHOLE-CLIP aggregate and is therefore not a causal mid-clip alarm signal (see causality below)
spatial_feature.choice_rationale: raw speed scored HIGHER on development data (AUC 0.855 vs 0.806). The normalised form is the conservative choice, taken to reduce the apparent-size confound, not the flattering one.

normalisation.reference_distribution: the development carve, stored explicitly below
normalisation.guarantee: primary scores are ranked against these stored carve values. The reference travels inside this artifact, so the confirmatory run cannot normalise primary against its own distribution.

calibration.tie_break: highest threshold among those with the identical confusion matrix

parameters_frozen.weight_status: FIXED design choice, NOT fitted, never searched

calibration.tie_break: highest threshold among those with the identical confusion matrix

operating_point.method: false-positive budget matched to the incumbent on development data
operating_point.budget_rationale: turns each threshold into a calibration constant rather than a fitted parameter and reduces the comparison to recall at a matched alarm rate
operating_point.grid: every distinct score value present in the development set
operating_point.determinism: total order on (|fp - budget|, -tp, -threshold); no RNG
operating_point.if_budget_unreachable: the closest achievable false-positive count is taken and exact_budget_match is recorded false; the protocol is not relaxed

confirmatory_analysis.when: only after explicit authorisation, in a separate task
confirmatory_analysis.comparison: B0_temporal_only versus the frozen fusion candidates, paired

primary_endpoint.question: does the frozen fusion detector improve paired clip-level classification over the frozen temporal-only incumbent?
primary_endpoint.statistic: exact McNemar on discordant pairs, two-sided
primary_endpoint.direction: improvement = fusion correct where B0 is wrong, more often than the reverse
primary_endpoint.ties: concordant pairs are uninformative for McNemar and are reported but not tested; zero discordant pairs is reported as p = 1

secondary_endpoints: confusion matrices, accuracy, precision, recall, specificity, F1
ROC-AUC and PR-AUC for score-valued candidates (B0, B1); not defined for the boolean OR gate
Wilson intervals on accuracy and recall
paired percentile bootstrap of the accuracy difference, clip-level AND source-video-clustered
false-alarm non-inferiority against a margin of 10 clips
confirmatory_analysis.secondary_significance: NOT required in every secondary metric; secondaries are descriptive support

bootstrap.pairing: clips resampled as pairs, both arms together

interpretation.A_improved: McNemar p < 0.05 with fusion favoured: report fusion as improving the detector, with effect size and CI
interpretation.B_directional: point estimate favours fusion but p >= 0.05: report directional evidence, insufficient for superiority
interpretation.C_no_improvement: no meaningful difference: report that spatial evidence did not translate into improved fused classification under the frozen protocol
interpretation.D_degraded: McNemar p < 0.05 against fusion: reject fusion for the final detector

prohibited_after_seeing_primary: inventing a success criterion not stated above

causality.temporal_branch: causal: completed windows only, frozen aggregation, first-alarm at (last_frame + 1)/30, scanning stops at the first fire
causality.spatial_branch_feature: NOT causal as frozen: it is a whole-clip aggregate over all 150 frames
causality.consequence: the frozen fusion decision is a CLIP-LEVEL OFFLINE decision. It is a fair comparison with B0, which also consumes all 17 windows, but it is not a mid-clip alarm and must not be described as one
causality.streaming_variant: a prefix-mean version is computable but is NOT part of this protocol and has not been evaluated
causality.measured_throughput: 42.5-84 s per 5 s clip on CPU (YOLO-bound), i.e. 8.5x-16.8x slower than real time

reproducibility.seed_calibration: none required; calibration is deterministic with no RNG
